g.text: No switch, no coin cell, no controller: the badge's I2C master talks straight to the Nunchuk at address 0x52.

g.desc: No switch, no coin cell, no controller: the badge's I2C master talks straight to the Nunchuk at address 0x52.

g.text: Badge-driven: the SAO 3.3 V feeds the Nunchuk and both Qwiic sockets directly. Nothing on this board can feed a cell.

g.desc: Badge-driven: the SAO 3.3 V feeds the Nunchuk and both Qwiic sockets directly. Nothing on this board can feed a cell.

g.text: J2 is the maker's edge-finger tongue: the Wii Nunchuk cable plug slides onto it. Finger 2 is unused by a Nunchuk.

g.desc: J2 is the maker's edge-finger tongue: the Wii Nunchuk cable plug slides onto it. Finger 2 is unused by a Nunchuk.

g.text: J3 and J4: Qwiic (JST SH) sockets that pass the same bus on to other I2C boards. Shells to GND.

g.desc: J3 and J4: Qwiic (JST SH) sockets that pass the same bus on to other I2C boards. Shells to GND.
